Frequently asked questions
 See all FAQs
 How long does it take to connect my Shopify store?
Most stores connect in under five minutes. After you authorize the Malachyte app in Shopify, we sync your catalog automatically — a full catalog import typically finishes within an hour, depending on the number of products and variants.
 What's the difference between Promote, Boost, Bury, and Hide rules?
Promote forces matching products toward the top of results, and Boost nudges them up by a weighted amount without guaranteeing a position. Bury pushes products down, and Hide removes them from results entirely. Promote and Hide are absolute; Boost and Bury are relative.
 Can I test rule changes before they go live?
Yes. The Playground lets you edit rules against any persona and see the resulting product grid instantly, without affecting your live storefront. When you're happy with the outcome, deploy the configuration with one click.
 Why is a product not appearing in recommendations?
The most common causes are an out-of-stock status, a Hide or Bury rule matching the product, or the item still syncing from your catalog. Open Recommendation Diagnostics to see the exact rules affecting any result row and why it ranked where it did.
 How often does my catalog sync with Malachyte?
Catalog changes, including new products, price updates, and inventory levels, all sync in near real time through Shopify webhooks. A full reconciliation also runs on a daily schedule to catch anything a webhook may have missed.
